title: ononis natrix proles hispanica
intro: Ononis natrix proles hispanica, commonly known as Spanish restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving pain, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Spanish restharrow include its ability to reduce fever, soothe wounds, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions involve analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids.
